description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

The hiring client is an unnamed growth-stage defense technology company. It is hiring software engineers to build and iterate on customer-facing capabilities with users in the field, from discovery and prototyping through end-to-end development.
Forward Deployed Software Engineer contributing to end-to-end feature development and diagnosing customer pain points on site

Responsibilities:
• Visit customer sites to diagnose and understand pain points
• Take part in end-to-end development of new features and capabilities
• Iterate quickly to unlock customer value step by step
• Write clean, testable, maintainable code

Requirements:
• U.S. citizenship
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
• 1+ years of front-end or back-end development experience (SQL, Java, and/or TypeScript/React)
• Ability to work independently with little supervision
• A strong desire to work in a challenging, fast-paced tech environment

Preferred:
• An active U.S. security clearance, or the ability to obtain one with sponsorship
• Startup or entrepreneurial experience
• Experience working within a federally accredited software environment
• Experience in a customer-facing or consulting role
